model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the negative log probability values for a model fine-tuned on different medical specialties. The horizontal axis displays six categories: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, presented in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and spans a range from approximately -27 to -22, with tick labels at regular intervals of 1. Each category is represented by three bars, colored orange, tan, and light blue, representing different model versions. The light blue bar for Cardio has a value of approximately -23.8, while the tallest orange bar for Pediatrics reaches approximately -22.2. The bars within each category show a generally decreasing trend from left to right, with the light blue bars consistently shorter than the orange and tan bars. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation.
